name: claude-mcp

tools.name: query
tools.description: Execute a Claude Code query with full control over SDK options.

prompt.description: The prompt/message to send to Claude. Supports @-mention syntax for including files (e.g., '@package.json', '@src/**/*.js')

sessionId.description: Optional session/response ID to resume a previous conversation. If not provided, starts a new conversation.

async.description: Whether to execute asynchronously (returns task ID) or synchronously (returns result directly)

maxTurns.description: Maximum number of conversation turns Claude can take (default: 10)

allowedTools.description: List of tools Claude is allowed to use. If not specified, all tools are available.

disallowedTools.description: List of tools Claude is NOT allowed to use. Takes precedence over allowedTools.

systemPrompt.description: Custom system prompt to replace the default. Use this OR appendSystemPrompt, not both.

appendSystemPrompt.description: Text to append to the default system prompt. Use this OR systemPrompt, not both.

workingDirectory.description: Working directory for Claude to execute in. Defaults to current directory.

additionalDirectories.description: Additional directories to include in Claude's context

env.description: Environment variables to set for the Claude session

permissionMode.description: Permission mode for Claude's operations. 'bypassPermissions' allows full functionality.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Get the current status of a running or completed task by ID.

taskId.description: The task ID to check status for

tools.name: cancel
tools.description: Cancel a running task by ID.
